title: How to Create Impactful Thought Leadership Content
finding: 73% of decision-makers say thought leadership is a more trustworthy basis for assessing capabilities than traditional marketing materials; strong content should be accurate, digestible, shareable, actionable and relevant.

title: How B2B Marketers Can Use Thought Leadership to Persuade Hidden Buyers
finding: Hidden buyers value distinctive style, straightforward presentation and human, accessible insight; more than 40% of B2B deals stall because of buying-group misalignment.

title: Skills-based hiring
finding: Skills-first hiring continues to expand, increasing the value of explicit, evidence-backed capability signals rather than relying only on titles or pedigree.

title: Creating Helpful, Reliable, People-First Content
finding: Google emphasizes original information, first-hand expertise, clear authorship, useful sourcing, a clear site purpose, and people-first rather than search-engine-first content.

title: ProfilePage structured data
finding: ProfilePage markup helps Google understand a creator page; a clear mainEntity, accurate name, image and sameAs links support entity understanding.

title: Article structured data
finding: Google recommends accurate author markup and strongly recommends type plus author url or sameAs to help identify the person behind content.

title: Customizing your repository
finding: README, repository topics, social preview images and CITATION files can improve project discoverability, comprehension and professional presentation.

title: 29th Global CEO Survey — Middle East findings
finding: Middle East and GCC CEOs report AI adoption above global averages; 70% report a clearly defined AI roadmap, while leaders increasingly emphasize data readiness and governance before scaling AI.

title: EMEA Cloud Business Survey — Middle East Findings
finding: 86% plan to increase cloud investment, 51% use or plan sovereign public cloud, and 43% are already implementing and scaling agentic AI.

title: 2026 Global Digital Trust Insights — Middle East
finding: 62% expect cyber budgets to increase in 2026; 30% plan responsible-AI practices in the next 12 months, reinforcing trust and governance as executive priorities.

title: Middle East Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey 2025
finding: 75% of regional respondents used AI at work; 69% learned new skills in the past year; 85% say job security is a top priority when considering roles.

title: Your board bio: Storytelling to connect the dots
finding: A board bio is a tailored one-page summary, distinct from an executive CV, centered on board value proposition, governance relevance, career impact, credentials and intellectual capital.

title: Positioning Yourself for First-Time Board Service
finding: Board readiness benefits from a focused bio, explicit differentiation, profile raising through speaking/publishing, and networking with directors and executive-search firms.

title: Myths and Opportunities
finding: Many board opportunities are not advertised; being known as an expert and widening professional networks increases the odds of being considered.

title: Guidepoint Advisors
finding: Experienced executives and specialists can register interest for compensated expert-network engagements; Guidepoint states that clear role/responsibility detail improves matching.

title: Consulting Opportunities for Senior Executives & Industry Leaders
finding: GLG offers senior executives flexible expert engagements and explicitly positions them as a way to extend expertise, influence decision-makers and build leadership visibility, subject to compliance.

title: ORCID for Researchers
finding: ORCID provides a free persistent identifier that connects research, affiliations and contributions across institutions and geographies, improving discoverability and attribution.
